04

An Araldite adhesive dispenser container, injection-moulded from a 30% LIMEX + 70% PP blend. The 3D model is matched to the supplied reference photos: knurled white screw cap, smooth body, fluted lower grip section and blue flip-top dispensing base. Approximately 23% of the finished part mass is limestone.
